editionLabel: Ravensburger Dutch rulebook, file 27029; English summary
firstPlayerRule: Whoever was most recently hissed at by a cat starts. Continue clockwise after each player's turn.
officialTieBreak: Otherwise, the oldest player starts, as the rulebook instructs.
clarifications: Each turn consists of the Crew Action phase followed by the Encounter phase.
interpretation: This is an English summary of the cited Dutch rulebook.
evidenceNotes: Rendered pages 2 and 3 were inspected, as was the credits page. The publisher product link is labeled EN, but the retrieved instructions are Dutch. The answer follows the actual Dutch text, not the link label. The product page also contains unrelated descriptive copy; the manual itself identifies Fate of the Nostromo. No year has been inferred from artwork copyright.

location: Setup step 6; Playing the Game; end-of-round step 7
firstPlayerRule: Whoever last lit a candle starts. Play proceeds clockwise.
officialTieBreak: If there is doubt about who should start, choose the oldest player.
clarifications: A later round begins with the player to the left of whoever took the last turn of the previous round.
evidenceNotes: All three cited pages were inspected as rendered images. The oldest-player instruction belongs to initial setup. The left-neighbor rule applies to later rounds. No publication year has been inferred from the download URL.

gameName: Chronicles of Light: Darkness Falls – Disney Edition
location: Setup step 8; Gameplay; Leader; Single Player and credits
firstPlayerRule: There are no individual turns. Whoever most recently watched a Disney movie becomes the first round's Leader.
clarifications: Give that player the Leader Badge. The group chooses actions together; the Leader guides the discussion and has the final say if players disagree.
The solo game uses two Heroes and the two-player setup.
houseFallback: If the movie criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose the first Leader randomly. This is a house rule.
evidenceNotes: All four cited pages were inspected as rendered images. The movie criterion assigns the Leader rather than a conventional first turn. Later-round leadership has not been conflated with initial setup. The source footer identifies copyright 2024 and EN01.

editionLabel: Ravensburger German rules, article 20 902 6; English summary
location: German cover and opening-play instruction on page 4
firstPlayerRule: Whoever makes the cheekiest monkey face goes first.
interpretation: This is an English summary of the German section of the multilingual rulebook. The rule does not specify how to judge the faces.
uncertainty: Other language sections use different wording; this record applies only to the identified German instruction.
evidenceNotes: The rendered German cover and page 4 were inspected. The rule refers specifically to a monkey grimace. The Italian text instead refers to a monkey sound, so the different language instructions have not been merged into a universal criterion. No clockwise direction is inferred from the German word reihum.

editionLabel: Ravensburger English board-game rules, copyright 2017, file 234981
location: Cover identifies the board game; How to Play on the second unnumbered PDF page
firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently went on a treasure hunt starts. Turns then proceed clockwise.
clarifications: On a turn, first shift the maze, then move your playing piece.
evidenceNotes: Both rendered pages were inspected. The actual linked English rulebook gives the treasure-hunt criterion. A youngest-player instruction from another edition has not been substituted. The source is the board game, not the card game or a themed Labyrinth title. The second page shows copyright 2017 and file code 234981.

gameName: Star Wars Villainous: Power of the Dark Side
editionLabel: Ravensburger English base-game rules, copyright 2022, EN01
location: Setup step 7; credits and back-cover edition code
firstPlayerRule: Use the game's playful criterion—whoever last used the Force—or let the oldest player start.
officialTieBreak: Choosing the oldest player is an official alternative, not just a tie-break.
clarifications: The first player starts with no Credits, the second with one, and the third and fourth with two each.
evidenceNotes: Setup page 3, credits page 19 and the EN01 back cover were visually inspected. Page 2's clipped spread duplicates some extracted text from page 3, but the actual starting passage is visible on page 3. The oldest-player alternative is connected by or; it is not restricted to a tie. The source identifies the original five-Villain Power of the Dark Side set.

location: Set Up the Game — Players; Turn Structure; footer edition information
firstPlayerRule: Whoever sat at the table first takes the first turn and receives the starting-player hat.
clarifications: In a three- or four-player game, the starter places their piece on starting space 1; the others fill the next spaces in turn order.
With two players, the starter's pieces occupy spaces 1 and 3, and the other player's pieces occupy spaces 2 and 4.
evidenceNotes: All three cited pages were inspected as rendered images. The setup paragraph specifies both the selection criterion and the two-player positions. Turn Structure confirms the hat holder performs the first complete turn. The copyright year is printed in the file, not inferred from a product listing or download timestamp.

editionLabel: Ravensburger Italian Universal Monsters rules, copyright 2021, IT01; English summary
location: Universal Monsters cover; Come si gioca — Primo Giocatore and turn sequence; Solitario; credits
firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently ate garlic starts. Continue clockwise after each player's turn.
clarifications: A turn consists of the Hero phase followed by the Monster phase.
Solo play uses one Hero, starts the Terror Level at 3, and excludes the Courier Hero.
interpretation: This is an English summary of the cited Italian Universal Monsters rulebook.
evidenceNotes: The rendered cover, starting instruction, solo section and credits were inspected. This is the original Universal Monsters game, not American Monsters. The Italian source PDF was found directly on the publisher's file host; no claim is made that the UK product page links this file. The credits state copyright 2021 and IT01. A 2023 production timestamp is not treated as the copyright year.
